use: Opening briefing background for Geopolitics / WW3
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: cinematic full-bleed opening-screen background for the fictional strategy game GEOPOLITICS / WW3, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: a striking, premium high-tech war graphic about global resources and four competing powers, grounded near-future military-industrial technology rather than fantasy.
Scene: a dramatic elevated view of a vast dark strategic command environment merging into a luminous curved Earth on the RIGHT half, Arctic ice and continental silhouettes visible, fine teal tactical arcs connecting Europe, the Pacific and South America. A few sleek reconnaissance drones cross the upper right; below them, a naval task group and distant industrial shoreline with data-center lights, energy infrastructure and cranes suggest the material machinery of conflict. Restrained amber-orange conflict glows punctuate the ocean and horizon. Layered mist, brushed-metal detail, subtle topographic contour lines and crisp technical geometry, sophisticated cinematic concept art, convincing light and scale.
Composition: wide cinematic panorama. Keep the LEFT 50 percent and center-left predominantly deep navy shadow and atmospheric negative space, quiet and low contrast, so a 180-word white HTML briefing can sit over it. Concentrate the spectacular Earth, drones, ships and fine HUD-like geometry in the right half. Leave safe margins. The image itself must contain NO lettering, labels, numbers, logos, flags, borders, UI cards, or watermark; all text will be rendered separately by the game.
Lighting and palette: dark ink navy and steel blue matching a strategic command interface, luminous cool teal, a few warm amber sparks, deep blacks, dramatic rim light, serious tense atmosphere. Highly polished, detailed and beautiful; no gore, no people, no nuclear mushroom clouds, no outer-space fleets, no cartoon look.
notes: Generated for this project. Narrative and interface text are rendered separately as accessible HTML. Original generated PNG copied without image edits.
